about: Hi, I'm Soikot Sarkar. I recently completed my M.Sc. (Engineering) in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, specializing in Electronics and Photonics, at the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET). I earned my B.Sc. (Engineering) in Electrical and Electronic Engineering from Shahjalal University of Science and Technology (SUST), where I also completed a second major in Computer Science and Engineering. My research interests include nanophotonics, metasurfaces, photonic integrated circuits, and optoelectronic devices.
